parsed_response.reasoning: The diff confirms the mechanism: GoogleCalendarService.createEvent now computes `selectedCalendar = calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId` and falls back to `calendarId: selectedCalendar || "primary"`. Previously it used `destinationCalendar?.externalId` directly. In EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents, the no-credentialId branch calls `createEvent(c, event)` for each matching-type credential with no credentialId-based destination, so destinations lacking a matching credentialId silently fall to the account's primary calendar instead of the previously selected sub-calendar — a verifiable behavior change that can misplace bookings with no error surfaced.

judged_text: createEvent now resolves the target calendar solely via `destinationCalendar.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)`, so any destination calendar whose credentialId is unset or does not match the credential executing the call falls through to `calendarId: "primary"`. Pre-refactor destination calendars (and the no-credentialId branch of createAllCalendarEvents that calls `createEvent(c, event)` without a matching destination) silently switch from creating events in the user's selected sub-calendar (the old `destinationCalendar?.externalId` behavior) to creating them in the Google account's primary calendar, misplacing bookings with no error surfaced.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `createEvent` now chooses `selectedCalendar` only via `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId`, and then falls back to `"primary"` when not found (`calendarId: selectedCalendar || "primary"`). Pre-change behavior selected by `destinationCalendar.externalId` directly. The diff also shows branches that can call `createEvent` with credentials that may not match any `destinationCalendar[].credentialId` (e.g., `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` else-branch when `destination.credentialId` is falsy, it maps credentials by integration and calls `createEvent(c, event)` without ensuring a matching `destinationCalendar` entry for that credential). In those cases, even if a destination calendar externalId exists, Google events will be inserted into the account primary calendar silently, misplacing bookings.
